title: RIO Governed Action State Machine v0.1
description: Formal definition of the 16-state governed action lifecycle from RIO Operating Spec v0.1 §7. Vocabulary source: server/rio/specAlignment.ts (Patch Pack 1.1).

SIGNAL.description: Raw input received — not yet interpreted

PACKETIZED.description: Intent wrapped in governance packet with hash + metadata

PRECHECKED.description: Pre-commit validation complete (policy, risk, blast radius)

COMMITTED.description: Human has committed authority — authorization bound to proposal packet
COMMITTED.invariant: INV-4: COMMITTED ≠ GATE_VALIDATED. Human commitment binds authority. Gate validation confirms execution match. These are distinct events.

CLARIFY.description: Clarification requested — awaiting additional information from human
CLARIFY.note: First-class status. Action resumes after clarification.

HOLD.description: Action paused — awaiting condition or human decision

GATE_VALIDATED.description: Post-commit gate validation passed — execution request matches committed packet
evidence_sources: status/context flag proving gate validation occurred
EXECUTED or FAILED status (proves gate attempt)

BLOCKED.description: Action blocked by policy, gate, or kill switch
BLOCKED.note: Outcome is final (action will not execute), but the lifecycle continues through receipt and ledger recording.

REFUSED.description: Action refused by human decision — explicit rejection
REFUSED.note: Outcome is final (human said no), but the lifecycle continues through receipt and ledger recording.

FAILED.note: Outcome is final (execution failed), but the lifecycle continues through receipt and ledger recording.

RECORDED.description: Receipt written to ledger with hash chain linkage

LEARNED.description: Learning loop has processed the outcome

intake.description: Goal → Intent: raw input to structured governance packet

governance.description: Policy → Approval: human review, commitment, clarification, hold

execution.description: Gate → Execute: post-commit validation and execution

recording.description: Receipt → Ledger: cryptographic receipt and hash chain

PASS.description: All checks passed — action may proceed

WARN.description: Checks passed with advisory signals — proceed with caution

HOLD.description: Action paused — awaiting condition or decision

BLOCK.description: Denied by policy or gate — not permitted

REFUSE.description: Denied by human decision — explicit refusal

invariants.INV-1: Human Root Authority: human remains ultimate authority
invariants.INV-3: Proposal Before Movement: no action without prior proposal packet
invariants.INV-4: Commit ≠ Gate: COMMITTED and GATE_VALIDATED are distinct events
invariants.INV-5: Proposer ≠ Approver: structural separation or constrained delegation
invariants.INV-6: Token Lifecycle: issue → validate → burn, no reuse
invariants.INV-7: Receipt Completeness: all required fields present
invariants.INV-8: Ledger Integrity: append-only SHA-256 hash chain
invariants.INV-9: Context Cannot Expand Authority: context restricts, never grants
invariants.INV-10: Learning is Advisory: learning cannot approve, execute, or bypass
